_about: Translations for labels added after the forms were originally translated. Keys are the exact English strings on the form; tools/add_translations.py hashes them the way Jotform does (md5 of the text) and posts them. Session N is expanded for N = 1..15. The Club picker and static-field strings follow the training guide's exact wording (2026-09-12); translations were written by us - flag for native-speaker review like the Odia set.
